description: AGSC-05-05: an item that carries iri MUST carry the computed one, <site.base>/<type-plural>/<slug>/ (AGSC-05-01), and a mismatch is AGSC-E204 — the pattern class of the precedence paragraph, since the value fails the form the rule fixes. Derivation: with site.base https://example.org/ the concept at content/concepts/a.md computes to https://example.org/concepts/a/; https://other.example/concepts/a/ differs in its origin and is reported; the computed value itself passes; an item that carries no iri is outside the rule and passes. The trailing slash is part of the IRI (AGSC-05-01), so a value without it would also mismatch, but that case is not asserted here.
